description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, with five unclassified sources and no classified request, so demand remains unknown. A prior merchant-feed test could not tie its sample to a readable field-level rule. This turn targets that specific gap with the official Google Merchant Center specification and delegates an executed buyer-facing example if the rule is confirmed. The sample can proceed independently of catalogue terms approval. Offering binding paid terms still depends on operator approval, and public release requires independent review of the exact candidate.
